name: Race
definition: A single Grand Prix event in a championship season, identified by its season year and its round number within that season.
scope: Race-level analysis: calendars, race counts per season, per-race results.

name: Season
definition: A championship year that groups every race held in that year.
scope: Season-level aggregation and season-over-season comparison.

name: Driver
definition: A person who competes in races and is the subject of driver-level performance analysis.
scope: Driver identity and career-level aggregation.

name: Constructor
definition: The team or entrant that supplies the car a driver races for.
scope: Team-level aggregation and constructor championship analysis.

name: Circuit
definition: The permanent racing venue at which a race is held, with its location and geographic coordinates.
scope: Venue-level analysis and geographic grouping of races.

name: Race Result
definition: One entry in a race: the record of a single car and driver entry taking part in one race, carrying its grid slot, classification, points and completion status. A driver may hold more than one entry in the same race when a car was shared.
scope: Entry-level analysis of a race; the fact table for results, points and classification.

name: Race Entry Status
definition: The categorised outcome of a race entry, ranging from a normal finish through lapped classifications to specific mechanical or sporting failures.
scope: Grouping and filtering race entries by how the entry ended.

name: Lap
definition: One completed lap by one driver in one race, carrying its elapsed time and the driver's position on that lap.
scope: Lap-by-lap analysis such as pace evolution and position changes within a race.

name: Pit Stop
definition: One pit stop made by one driver in one race, numbered in sequence within that race.
scope: Pit strategy and pit crew performance analysis.

name: Qualifying Entry
definition: One driver's participation in the qualifying session of a race, carrying the qualifying position and the times set in each qualifying segment.
scope: Qualifying performance and starting-order analysis.

name: Driver Standing
definition: A driver's cumulative championship position, points and win total as they stood immediately after a given race.
scope: Championship-progress analysis; each row is a snapshot after one race.

name: Constructor Standing
definition: A constructor's cumulative championship position, points and win total as they stood immediately after a given race.
scope: Constructor championship-progress analysis; each row is a snapshot after one race.

name: Constructor Race Points
definition: The championship points credited to a constructor for a single race.
scope: Constructor scoring; not always equal to the constructor's drivers' combined points.

name: Championship Points
definition: The points credited to a driver for one race entry under the scoring system in force in that season.
scope: Driver scoring and season totals; unaffected entries score zero.

name: Finishing Position
definition: The official classified finishing position of a race entry, carried only by entries that were classified.
scope: Ranking and counting classified finishers; absent for non-classified entries.

name: Classification Order
definition: The order in which every race entry is ranked for a race, placing classified finishers first and non-classified entries after them.
scope: Ordering and counting entries of any kind, including retirements.

name: Grid Position
definition: The starting position of a race entry on the starting grid, where zero denotes a start from the pit lane.
scope: Starting-order analysis and grid-to-finish comparisons.

name: Qualifying Position
definition: The position a driver achieved in the qualifying session that sets the provisional starting order.
scope: Qualifying performance analysis and pole determination.

name: Race Win
definition: A race entry placed first in the official classification order of its race.
scope: Victory counting; a shared car credits the same win to each of its drivers.

name: Podium Finish
definition: A race entry placed within the top three of the official classification order of its race.
scope: Top-three finish counting and podium rate analysis.

name: Pole Position
definition: The first position on the provisional starting order, earned by the fastest driver in qualifying.
scope: Qualifying-success analysis; defined only where qualifying data exists.

name: Fastest Lap
definition: The quickest single lap recorded by any driver during a race, ranked first among that race's recorded lap times.
scope: Single-lap pace analysis; available only for seasons with recorded lap-time fields.

name: Lap Time
definition: The elapsed time taken to complete one lap, recorded as a duration in milliseconds.
scope: Pace comparison within a race; comparable across races only with care for circuit and era.

name: Pit Stop Duration
definition: The elapsed stationary time of a pit stop, recorded as a duration in milliseconds.
scope: Pit crew performance analysis; available only for seasons with pit stop records.

name: Retirement
definition: A race entry that ended before the finish because of a mechanical failure, accident or other non-classification outcome.
scope: Reliability and attrition analysis; excludes normal and lapped finishes.

name: Shared Drive
definition: A single car raced by more than one driver in the same race, so that the same finishing result is credited to each of them.
scope: Historical entry counting; affects win and podium counts before 1979.

name: Car Number
definition: The number carried on the car in a race entry, which need not equal the driver's registered career number.
scope: Entry identification; not a stable identifier of a driver.

name: Driver Reference
definition: A stable human-readable identifier for a driver, used alongside the numeric surrogate key and a short driver code.
scope: Identity resolution when joining driver data across tables.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: The complete display name of a driver, assembled from the recorded given name and family name.
scope: Presentation and name-based lookup of drivers.

name: Country
definition: The country associated with a driver or constructor as a sporting nationality, or with a circuit as its physical location.
scope: Geographic grouping of drivers, constructors and venues.
